name: Russia–NATO
summary: Poland's security operation on the Kaliningrad border runs to at least 8 Nov; no Article 4 request
state: Poland's police chief said a security operation along the Kaliningrad border, with police, border guards, counter-terrorism units and GROM special forces, would run at least until 8 Nov, after PM Donald Tusk said suspicious movements were seen near the border on 3 Nov (The Financial; France 24). Border guards confirmed no crossing attempt, and no member had requested Article 4 consultations as of 8 Nov.
for_you: Check FCDO travel advice for Poland and the Baltic states; no change to travel guidance has been reported.
rubric_hit: Alleged provocation on NATO border, no Article 4 = Watch

sources.title: The Financial — Poland deploys more forces near Russian border after Kaliningrad incident
France 24 — Poland foils attempted provocation on Russian border, PM Tusk says

why: Direct Russia–NATO confrontation is the most likely path to a European war involving the UK.
drivers: Airspace and drone incursions, sabotage, Baltic incidents, nuclear signalling, Ukraine war spillover.

rubric.alert: Article 4 consultations, a direct military clash, or an attack on NATO territory.
rubric.watch: Airspace/drone violations, sabotage attributed to Russia, or explicit threats against members.
rubric.normal: No notable incidents on NATO territory in the past two weeks.
